title: Transport non-solvability from the normal subgroup 'Alt_T to 'Sym_T via series_sol
intent: To prove 'Sym_T is not solvable for 4 < #|T|, reduce solvability of the whole symmetric group to solvability of its normal subgroup 'Alt_T through the normal-series equivalence series_sol, then supply the already-proved non-solvability of 'Alt_T; the one-line glue never analyses the quotient 'Sym_T / 'Alt_T, which is dropped by false && _.
also_known_as: reduce solvability across a normal series

children.name: Alt_normal
children.note: The alternating group 'Alt_T is normal in 'Sym_T because it is the kernel of the sign morphism odd_perm; this supplies the H <| G premise that series_sol needs.

children.name: solvable_AltF
children.closed_by: apply/negP => Alt_solvable; simple_Alt5, simple_sol_prime, card_Alt, even_prime
children.note: The non-solvability of 'Alt_T for |T| > 4, the headline lemma of the section. It assumes 'Alt_T simple (simple_Alt5), derives from simple_sol_prime that a solvable simple group has prime order, then contradicts that with #|'Alt_T| = #|T|! %/ 2 via even_prime.

applicability.goal_shape: A goal solvable G = false (or ~ solvable G) for a group G that has a normal subgroup H <| G whose non-solvability is already proved as solvable H = false.
applicability.use_when: You can exhibit a normal subgroup H of G known to be non-solvable; series_sol rewrites solvable G to solvable H && solvable (G / H), and solvable H = false collapses the conjunction, so the quotient G / H never has to be analysed.
applicability.avoid_when: The quotient G / H matters (e.g. the downward direction solvable G -> solvable H forces proving solvability of G / H too); H is not normal, so series_sol does not apply; or the subgroup's non-solvability is not yet a rewrite lemma of the shape solvable H = false that a view like /solvable_AltF-> can fire on.

claims.claim: The parent lemma solvable_SymF is declared at solvable/alt.v:592-593.
The parent site cites the child Alt_normal.
The parent site cites the child solvable_AltF.
The library lemma series_sol that the glue applies is declared at solvable/nilpotent.v:735.
No admit, Admitted or Axiom closes any goal in the section holding the parent and its children (solvable/alt.v:54-593).
The parent site is 2 lines long.
The theorem is assembled from two direct project lemmas, and the work sits in the children, not the glue: the glue is one proof line (593) while the children take 2 and 12 lines (54-55, 579-590).

The same series_sol transport of solvability across a normal subgroup is reused elsewhere in the library: metacyclic_sol (nilpotent.v line 749) and setXn_sol (nilpotent.v line 768) both rewrite with series_sol to build solvability from a normal subgroup and its quotient.

metrics.how_counted: the parent's whole proof is the single line 593; children = the two project lemmas named in the glue; series_sol is the one non-project lemma the glue also applies

consequences: The move creates no exhaustiveness or side-condition obligation beyond the normality H <| G (Alt_normal) and the non-solvability of the subgroup (solvable_AltF). It relies on series_sol being an equivalence so the quotient factor can be dropped by false && _. Failure modes: (i) without an equation solvable H = false, the view => /solvable_AltF-> does not fire; (ii) for the upward direction (solvable H && solvable (G / H) -> solvable G) you must also prove the quotient solvable, so the one-line glue no longer suffices.
